schema_versions.notes: Breaking: `FluxLoop` keys renamed ([PR 929](https://github.com/awslabs/palace/pull/929)), `NSamples` removed ([PR 1049](https://github.com/awslabs/palace/pull/1049)), interior boundaries not cracked by default ([PR 994](https://github.com/awslabs/palace/pull/994)); see the [0.19.0 CHANGELOG](https://github.com/awslabs/palace/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#0190---2026-11-02) for more.

Breaking: frequency-domain energies and powers are time averages, and port excitations carry 1 W of incident power ([PR 937](https://github.com/awslabs/palace/pull/937)); `InitialGuess` defaults to `true` for adaptive frequency sweeps too ([PR 1126](https://github.com/awslabs/palace/pull/1126)); see the [0.20.0 CHANGELOG](https://github.com/awslabs/palace/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#0200---2026-11-23) for more.
